name: Georgia
description: Georgia from Colchis and Iberia to Queen Tamar's golden age, Russian rule, Stalin, independence, the Rose Revolution and the war of 2008.

checkpoints.name: Colchis and Iberia
checkpoints.note: Colchis in the west and Iberia in the east were the first Georgian kingdoms.

checkpoints.name: Christian kingdoms
checkpoints.note: Saint Nino brought Christianity. David the Builder and Queen Tamar ruled a golden age, before Mongols, Persians and Ottomans.

checkpoints.name: Russian and Soviet rule
checkpoints.note: Russia took Georgia in the 1800s. A republic of 1918 fell to the Red Army in 1921, and Stalin, a Georgian, ruled the Soviet Union.

checkpoints.name: Independent Georgia
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1991, then civil war, the Rose Revolution, war with Russia in 2008 and a struggle over the road to Europe.
